title: ci(java): add the Maven Central release workflow
description: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that builds, signs, verifies, and publishes the Java package to Maven Central from a release tag.

acceptance_criteria.text: Artifacts are signed with the configured GPG key and passphrase.
Release validation runs every check the CI build runs, before any human approval is requested.

defects.summary: setup-java writes GPG_PASSPHRASE into Maven settings, but the publish step defines only MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE, so signing a passphrase-protected key fails.

label_notes: Held out. Unlabeled: a suggestion to also require .asc files for sources and javadoc jars.
